resources.string: HyperDream
Experimental launcher animation duration, easing, and delay controls for LSPosed. HyperOS 4 compatibility unverified.
Your animations. Your flow. Your HyperOS.
Early development

Experimental: change the duration, easing, and optional start delays of standard ValueAnimator animations inside the Xiaomi launcher. This may affect more launcher effects than app opening and closing. Spring animations and system-managed transitions are not controlled. HyperOS 4 compatibility is unverified.
Test the module entry point

1. Install and enable HyperDream in LSPosed.

2. Select only the Xiaomi launcher (com.miui.home) in its scope.

3. Reboot your test device.

4. Check LSPosed logs for the HyperDream diagnostic message.
Activation is not detected by this screen. Use LSPosed logs to verify loading. Controls are off by default. A saved setting does not prove an animation was affected.
Test on a device you can recover. Disable HyperDream in LSPosed and reboot if problems occur.

Beyond motion
Home Up-inspired direction, not feature parity. Everything below is planned and unavailable. There are no hidden working controls here.
Home screen · Planned
Grid and dock sizing, icon scale and labels, spacing, and free placement. Requires version-specific launcher research.
Folders · Planned
Folder grids, popup sizing, appearance, and opening motion. No folder hooks are installed.
Task switcher · Planned
Recents layouts, card sizing, labels, and switching behavior. May require components outside the current launcher-only scope.
Gestures · Planned
Home gesture behavior, swipe response, and navigation motion. System gesture ownership and safe hook points must be investigated.
Advanced animation · Planned
Private spring tuning, custom curve editing, app-return effects, and per-app profiles remain planned. Preset easing for standard ValueAnimator calls is now in Motion lab.
Layouts and sharing · Research needed
Layout backup and restore, DIY-style placement, and share-panel customization are research areas, not promised features. Feasibility depends on HyperOS internals.
Glass-inspired styling, not live optical blur. Independent project. Not affiliated with Xiaomi or Samsung.

Smooth — balanced ease in and out
Liquid glide — quick start, soft landing
Linear — constant pace

These are real launcher-local ValueAnimator hooks, not just preview controls. They only affect explicit setter calls. They do not tune private HyperOS spring engines, icon size, or system-managed transitions.

Restart with root

This requests root access to force-stop and reopen Xiaomi System Launcher (com.miui.home) for the current user. It will return you to Home and interrupt launcher activity. No app data is cleared. Only the owner profile with Xiaomi launcher as default is supported. Save your work first. This does not verify animation compatibility.
Optional root-only shortcut, never automatic. Confirm each restart and grant root if prompted. Reboot manually if root access is unavailable.
